MONSTERS OF GALACTICON: BASIC line 210 asks WHICH WEAPON? (R,S OR T). Line 220 reads the letter. Each encounter changes based on the monster and chosen weapon. There is no movement control.

In Fuse 48K at 400% speed, load the source TZX for 5 seconds, press Enter for 0.08 seconds, wait 0.5 seconds, then R and Enter to run the loaded listing. Wait 1.2 seconds for the first monster. Enter R and Enter, wait 0.35 seconds, then enter S and Enter, and wait 0.35 seconds. Keys are held for 0.08 seconds, then released with a 0.16-second pause. REPLAY.sh captures the first prompt and both results. The random monster order can differ each run.
